explanation: Nested elements must have mathematically correct radius — outer radius equals inner radius plus the padding between them
applies_to: Cards inside cards and buttons inside containers and any nested rounded elements

explanation: Crisper text rendering on macOS — prevents subpixel antialiasing which looks blurry on dark backgrounds
applies_to: All text globally — add to body or root element

explanation: Prevents number width shifts in dynamic content — all digits occupy equal width so counters and prices don't jump
applies_to: Counters and prices and stats and timers and any changing numbers

explanation: Distributes words evenly across lines in headings — prevents orphan words on the last line
applies_to: Headings and titles — NOT body text (balance can look odd on paragraphs)

explanation: Prevents orphan words at end of paragraphs by adjusting line breaks — less aggressive than balance
applies_to: Body paragraphs and descriptions — complement to balance on headings

explanation: Never use transition: all — it animates properties you did not intend and causes layout thrash. Always list specific properties
applies_to: All elements with transitions — e.g. transition: transform 200ms ease-out and opacity 200ms ease-out

explanation: Only use will-change on transform and opacity — using it on other properties wastes memory and can cause worse performance
applies_to: Elements with frequent animations — remove will-change when animation completes

explanation: Use 2-3 shadow layers at different offsets and opacities instead of one solid shadow — creates more natural depth. E.g. 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.07) and 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)
applies_to: Cards and elevated surfaces — replaces solid borders for depth

explanation: Tactile press feedback — button visually compresses on click. Never go below 0.95 (feels broken). 0.96-0.97 is the sweet spot
applies_to: All interactive buttons and clickable cards

explanation: Some elements look misaligned even when pixel-perfect — optical alignment means adjusting by eye. Play icons need right-shift and triangles need vertical offset
applies_to: Icons inside circles and play buttons and asymmetric shapes and logos next to text
